title: Biquadratic SOS Rank and Augmented Zarankiewicz Number
summary: This paper introduces the concepts of the augmented Zarankiewicz number $z_A(m,n)$ and the limited augmented Zarankiewicz number $z_L(m,n)$, which are natural combinatorial extensions of the classical Zarankiewicz number. These numbers arise from augmented bipartite graphs that may contain both standard edges (1-edges) and pairs of edges representing squares of binomials (2-edges). The main theoretical result establishes the inequality chain $\operatorname{BSR}(m, n) \geq z_A(m, n) \geq z_L(m, n) \geq z(m, n)$, linking the maximum biquadratic sum-of-squares (SOS) rank to these extremal graph…
